comment: A document of 1920 by 1280 with the harness's photograph imported as a layer the size of the canvas, fitted and zoomed to a half, so a screen pixel is two of the document's and the canvas stands at (503.6, 219.7). The middle of the photograph, document (480, 320) to (1440, 960), is selected and the Transform picked under Perspective. The top left corner, at screen (744, 380), is dragged 75 screen pixels left, 150 document pixels, and the top right corner goes 150 right with it, the top widened on both sides, for the look. Escape puts it back, and the same drag with Shift held moves the one corner. Escape again, and the left corner dragged 75 screen pixels up takes the bottom left 150 document pixels down. Last the pointer rests on the strip's Perspective cell, the second over the box's top left, and the tooltip it shows is reported and shot.
